about: US steel data for the IBBA data desk (Steel > US market). Sources: US Census Bureau (FT900A imports; International Trade API exports, AISI product list), AISI (mill shipments, weekly raw steel), worldsteel (crude steel), Federal Reserve G.17 (capacity utilization, raw steel index). Tonnes are metric unless the key ends in _nt (net tons). Built by Steel and Mining/update_us_steel.py - do not edit by hand.
